TITLE: Voting intention, 13-14 September 2026: Lab 23%, Ref 23%, Con 20%, LD 13%, Grn 11%
PUBLISHED: 
FETCHED: 2026-09-22 (curl, full article)

Latest YouGov Westminster voting intention figures

The latest YouGov voting intention poll for The Times and Sky News shows an unchanged close race between the three largest parties, with Reform UK and Labour both on 23% of the vote and the Conservatives on 20% for the third consecutive week.

While all parties are within the margin of error of our previous poll, the 11% vote share recorded by the Greens is the lowest figure for the party in our tracker since September last year, and is down a full ten points from their peak in March. The Lib Dems are on 13% of the vote.
